status: Working native crop workflow: 47 focused tests, followed by 1,637 final full Release tests and a verified universal package. Full Photoshop parity remains open.
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0; native Swift adaptation; original Rust files unchanged

references.scope: Fill dropdown, resize/rotate/expand and Return commit
Aspect options, pixel deletion and outstanding crop preferences
Boundary, image positioning, rotation and straighten-line workflow
Image > Crop selection behavior and distinct scanned-photo/Ruler workflows

archive_change: None; existing raster/affine/channel/path storage. Retained crops preserve layer source storage; deleting ordinary raster pixels materializes only their canvas intersection.

menus.integration: Crop tool/C shortcut and Image > Crop use the same prepared native edit. Image > Crop deletes ordinary raster pixels outside the selected bounds. Existing menu layout and counts are unchanged.

first_full_release.cause: Outdated API catalogue counts; repaired in source02.

live: No live Photoshop/UI interaction; prior lock was not bypassed. Tests exercise native NSView event routing and procedural pixel output, not a live screenshot.
limits: Maximum16MP source/output canvas,64MP total materialized raster pixels and4MP content-aware-fill output. Larger requests fail explicitly.
Exact Photoshop resampling, synthesized pixels, crop-background context and default preferences remain unqualified.
Crop frame rotates over the original image; complete Photoshop auto-centered image-under-frame interactions, Classic Mode, crop shield preferences and overlay variants remain open.
W×H×Resolution/resampling mode, custom presets, physical units, perspective crop, Ruler workflow, Trim and automatic multi-photo crop/straighten remain open.
Delete Cropped Pixels applies to ordinary raster image storage. Smart Object sources, editable vectors/text and mask storage are retained; precise Photoshop storage behavior remains unqualified.
New fill patches contain only exposed gaps outside the original canvas; interior transparency remains. Existing off-canvas pixels exposed by a retained crop are reused.
Adobe auto-crop is automatic subject/object detection and has not been implemented by this manual crop increment. Manual crop actionJSON is also unsupported.
Full live, physical Intel and macOS14/26 qualification remain open.
